content: GGA fix quality: 0=no fix,1=GPS,2=DGPS,4=RTK fixed,5=RTK float,6=dead reckoning. Min 4 sats required for a fix, 6+ recommended for good HDOP. Common practice: HDOP mask ~6 for logging (reject above); tighter (<=2) for survey-grade. Lower HDOP = better satellite geometry / more reliable horizontal accuracy.
